name: How Far Can You Fling?
desc:
Get a running start up a ramp and fling yourself to fly as far as possible! 🏃 The further you travel, the more coins you will gain! 🪙 Use coins to purchase boosts like upgraded speed and rebirths! 🏆 Ascend your way up the leaderboards and become the fling master!

Be FIRST 🏆 to experience new updates by pressing FOLLOW. On phone or tablet? Tap •••, then tap [🔔FOLLOW].

Join the Tiny Gecko fan group: https://www.roblox.com/Groups/Group.aspx?gid=4148498
